notes.text: I-Blitz Split ku-Apple Watch: yixhume ne-akhawunti ye-iPhone yakho, ubone amabhalansi akho namaqembu avulekile, uthephe okuthi Ngikhokhile eqenjini lapho ukweleta khona, futhi wengeze ibhalansi yakho iyonke ebusweni bewashi noma ku-Smart Stack; uma isixhunyiwe, iwashi lisebenza lodwa.
I-app manje isikhuluma isiBengali, isiMalay nesiGreki: khetha "বাংলা", "Bahasa Melayu" noma "Ελληνικά" ku-Iphrofayela › Ulimi, noma uyivumele ilandele idivayisi yakho.
Amaqembu manje angasebenzisa i-taka yaseBangladesh ne-ringgit yaseMalaysia.
I-app manje isikhuluma isiCroatia: khetha "Hrvatski" ku-Iphrofayela › Ulimi, noma uyivumele ilandele idivayisi yakho.
I-app manje isikhuluma isiFilipino: khetha "Filipino" ku-Iphrofayela › Ulimi, noma uyivumele ilandele idivayisi yakho.
Amaqembu manje angahlukanisa nge-peso yasePhilippines (PHP, "₱"), futhi iqembu elakhiwe ePhilippines liqala ngalolu hlobo lwemali.
I-app manje isikhuluma isiHungary: khetha "Magyar" ku-Iphrofayela › Ulimi, noma uyivumele ilandele idivayisi yakho.

Engeza iwijethi ethi Amabhalansi ku-Home Screen noma ku-Lock Screen ye-iPhone noma ye-iPad yakho ukuze ubone ibhalansi yakho iyonke namaqembu akho avulekile ngokushesha; yithephe ukuze uvule i-Amabhalansi.

Amaqembu manje angasebenzisa izinhlobo zemali zaseBolivia, eVenezuela, eCosta Rica, eGuatemala, eHonduras, eNicaragua, eDominican Republic naseCuba, futhi iqembu elakhiwe lapho liqala ngohlobo lwemali yakhona.
I-app manje isikhuluma isiSerbia: khetha "Srpski" ku-Iphrofayela › Ulimi, noma uyivumele ilandele idivayisi yakho.
Amaqembu manje angahlukanisa nge-dinar yaseSerbia (RSD), futhi iqembu elakhiwe eSerbia liqala ngalolu hlobo lwemali.
I-app manje isikhuluma isi-Urdu: khetha "اردو" ku-Iphrofayela › Ulimi, noma uyivumele ilandele idivayisi yakho.
Amaqembu manje angahlukanisa nge-rupee yasePakistan (PKR), futhi iqembu elakhiwe ePakistan liqala ngalolu hlobo lwemali.
Ukuthepha isaziso sesindleko esisha kuvula isindleko ngokushesha: i-app isiletha ngokushesha lapho isaziso sifika.
Isikrini sokwamukela kumafoni manje sibonisa ilogo kuphela phezulu, kushiya isikhala esengeziwe sezinkinobho.

Isibhengezo seqembu esithi "Sekuyisikhathi sokuxazulula izikweletu" asisabonisi usuku lwesikhumbuzi lwangaphambi kokuba isikhumbuzi sisethwe noma sishintshwe: isikhumbuzi esishintshelwe kumhla ka-25 silinda umhla ka-25.
